vision.name: Orange Punishment
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Physical attack.
Lower your opponent's anger 1. Raise your anger 1. If your MP has changed levels this combat, destroy an opponent's Setup or Drill.
DAMAGE: AT + 3 stages.
HIT: After a player draws a card this turn, that player discards a card from their hand.
(Banish after use.)
(Created by Jeff Sosa, OP3 North Kai Champion)
